description:
Create a new chat room (MUC room) inside an app the caller owns. Every room created this way is listed in the app's rooms (`defaultRooms`). By default it is an open room every user of the app joins automatically (`pinned: true` also pins it in their lists). `membersOnly: true` makes a private room instead: nobody joins it automatically and only people added with `ethora-chat-members-add` (and invited agents) can enter; that tool is in the `rooms` group, listed after `ethora-tools-enable { group: "rooms" }`. Returns the new room object including its JID.
Requires: a selected app (`ethora-app-select`) or an explicit `appId`.
Auth: user-auth mode, active session; the caller must own the app. Errors: 401 not logged in; 403 not owner; 404 unknown `appId`; 422 invalid `title` (or `membersOnly` on a server that predates it).

appId.description: 24-char hex ObjectId of the app to create the chat room in. Optional — defaults to the app most recently passed to `ethora-app-select`.

membersOnly.description: If `true`, a private members-only room: nobody is added automatically, add people with `ethora-chat-members-add`. If `false` (default), an open room the app's users join automatically.

pinned.description: If `true`, the room is pinned at the top of users' room lists. Whether users join it automatically is decided by `membersOnly`, not by this flag.

title.description: Display name for the new chat room. Visible to all members; not required to be unique within the app.

name: ethora-chat-create
title: Create Chat Room
